items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: They had some tough women too, Ron.

ctx.x: Well, she killed Black Benny, didn't she? She's the one who killed Black Benny. Yeah.
Thought she was tough, huh? Was she? They had some tough women too, Ron. What did she do?
Hustlin'. Did they, those women fight with their hands, Rebel? Yeah. Fight just like a man.
